notes: AVoice::View is 0x1c on Xbox, 0x20 on PS2 (3 per AVoice): AVoice 0x58 vs 0x64. Views typed as byte[84] for want of a View type.

AEngine::Get 0x12f940 is static (cdecl): looks the name up (0x12f8b0 -> 0x125270), else allocates 0x54 and constructs with 0x12fc60 (not AEngine::AEngine 0x12edd0) - an AEngine subclass of size 0x54 exists; it then sets vehicle/+0x10/+0x14/+0x18/+0x1c and returns the object.

AIndex::Lookup(int) 0x126d10 returns a char* (static default 0x189fb1 when missing, else entry+0x10); Lookup(char*) 0x126d40 returns int (-1 when missing or name null). AIndexMap holds two MSVC trees (+0x0 and +0xc), so it is probably 0x18 bytes; not created.
ASubmersible ctor zeroes ABaseSound +0x70/+0x74 (maxDistance, maxDistanceSq) and sets vehicleType (+0xd0) = 4; AHelicopter ctor writes +0x6c..0x74.
ATrafficVehicle +0x21c/+0x21d guard two global counters (0x243b5c, 0x243b60) decremented in the dtor - probably counts of active traffic/siren vehicles.
ATrafficVehicle::PlaySnowmobileSpecifics and ASnowMobile share constants (0x3df4ca92/0x3df4ccab), consistent with the name.
ABasic +0xc4 length (44) is only the gap to the end; PS2 ABasic size not checked.
